tips_en: Read VibePrevisBench first: it provides a concrete, still-unresolved testbed for whether multimodal agents build temporally correct scenes and produce legible control videos, while revealing that visual grounding, camera staging, and self-correction remain major bottlenecks. Duo v1 is the natural conceptual follow-up because it targets synchronized, responsive audiovisual generation, while MMFlash complements both by improving inference efficiency over long visual contexts.
tips_zh: 建议先读 VibePrevisBench：它提供了一个具体且尚未解决的多模态智能体评测框架，揭示了视觉理解、镜头与分镜编排以及自我纠错等关键瓶颈。Duo v1 是自然的后续阅读，因为它进一步追求同步且能响应用户的视听生成；MMFlash 则从系统效率侧补足长视觉上下文推理的瓶颈。
